product.title: Clear Kayak or Paddleboard Manatee Adventure

description.text: Take a break from the hustle and bustle of Orlando and spend time in nature with this kayaking tour through Silver Springs State Park. Ideal for nature lovers, this wildlife-focused activity offers the opportunity to see manatees (depending on the season), turtles, and wild birds in their native habitats. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Central Florida's wildlife, coastlines, and space-coast sights. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
